analysis: Changing the FM backend from bpr_censored_watch to pointwise while restoring the official binary long_view target produced a clearly worse standalone model. The primary metric dropped by -0.00512 with a 95% paired CI of [-0.00699, -0.00333], excluding zero, so the degradation is statistically supported across seeds. Predictions were different from the parent, so the intervention did create a genuinely different scorer, but that difference was harmful rather than beneficial. The hoped-for portfolio diversification also did not materialize: portfolio delta was -0.000253 with CI crossing zero, so there is no evidence of compensating ensemble value. Slice diagnostics show the loss was broad-based, with only a small positive on tab 4 and near-flat behavior on the most popular item quartile; most other slices were negative. This supports the narrower conclusion that, for this parent FM stack, replacing censored-watch pairwise training with pointwise long_view optimization is inferior and does not earn promotion as an error diversifier.
next_lesson: Keep the official long_view target if needed, but preserve the pairwise censored-watch objective; objective-family switching alone was a net negative here.
